Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly synthesized the genealogical information gathered in Step 2. While the WebSurfer correctly identified that Theudebert I was the son of "Theodoric (Theodoric the Great)", the Planner failed to distinguish between "Theodoric the Great" (King of the Ostrogoths, father of Theudebert I) and "Theuderic I" (King of Austrasia, father of Theudebert II). The Planner erroneously concluded that Wisigard's father-in-law was "Theodoric the Great" based on the name match in the search snippet, but the historical record indicates that Theudebert I's father was actually Theuderic I (also known as Theuderic I of Austrasia), not Theodoric the Great. The Planner made a factual error in identifying the specific individual named in the source, confusing two different historical figures with similar names.
